_meta.note: Small demo catalog mapping product versions to well-known CVEs. Scores and vectors follow NVD/CISA-ADP at time of writing; for production, sync from NVD instead of maintaining by hand.
_meta.match: product name only (CPE vendors differ between scanners and NVD)

entries.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal and remote code execution
entries.description: A flaw in path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allows path traversal to files outside the document root; with mod_cgi enabled it leads to remote code execution.

entries.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49-2.4.50 path traversal and remote code execution (incomplete fix)
entries.description: The fix for CVE-2021-41773 was incomplete; URL-encoded path traversal still works on 2.4.49 and 2.4.50.

entries.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.17-2.4.38 local privilege escalation (scoreboard)
entries.description: A child process running as an unprivileged user can execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the parent process (root) via the scoreboard.

entries.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup remote code execution (Log4Shell)
entries.description: Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other endpoints, allowing remote code execution through logged strings. This is a Java library, not part of Apache HTTP Server.

entries.title: OpenSSL TLS heartbeat information disclosure (Heartbleed)
entries.description: The TLS heartbeat extension in OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f lets remote attackers read process memory, exposing keys and credentials.

entries.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor command execution
entries.description: The vsftpd 2.3.4 download was backdoored; a username ending in a smiley face opens a root shell on TCP port 6200.

entries.title: Samba remote code execution via writable share (SambaCry)
entries.description: Samba 3.5.0 and later load a shared library supplied by a client from a writable share, leading to remote code execution.

entries.title: polkit pkexec local privilege escalation (PwnKit)
entries.description: pkexec mishandles an empty argument list, allowing an unprivileged local user to gain root.

entries.title: sudo heap overflow local privilege escalation (Baron Samedit)
entries.description: A heap-based buffer overflow in sudoedit/sudo -s allows any local user to gain root without authentication.

entries.title: OpenSSH username enumeration before 7.7
entries.description: OpenSSH before 7.7 reveals whether a username exists through differences in authentication failure handling.
